snippet.title: Ironseed 2 : Consensus Trailer
snippet.description:
Ironseed 2: Consensus is not a game about war. It's about survival without violence. Awakening without memory. And rebuilding with what little remains.

You begin alone aboard a damaged ship, lightyears from anything familiar. Systems flicker to life, one by one. Crew fragments, encoded in fractured memory, wait to be found. Their bodies must be rebuilt. A new home must be discovered.

No explosions. No time limits. Just exploration, decision, and purpose.
What do you do when there's no one left to fight… only something to become?

This is a journey for those who like to listen. To wonder. To linger in the silence between stars.

💠 Coming soon to Steam. Discover what was lost. Become something new.
